Only  thing  that  is  guaranteed  is  that  if 
 you  want  everything  from  life  you  will 
 get  nothing.  The  hard  choices  that  you 
 have  are  hard  because  you've  used  up  all 
 your  easy  decisions  already.  Wishing 
 that  they  were  easier  does  not  make  them 
 easier.  And  you've  got  to  pick 
 and  you've  got  to  live  with  the 
 consequences.  The  more  irreversible 
 decisions  you  make,  the  better  you  get 
 at  making  them. 
 But  you  got  to  start.
